saw_lines: Nobody buys a sofa on impulse. Buyers measure the room, compare pieces, then wait for a deal that justifies the price.
So the sale is won or lost in line one, where the buyer decides if the offer is worth a click.
Your site offers up to 70% off, but only 2 of 16 copy ads mention it, so open three new ads with the extra 20% off.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 24 Nov 2026
points: Only 2 of 16 copy ads mention your site’s 70% off, and 4 mention any offer. Buyers who see no discount in line one have no reason to act now. Open three new ads with the extra 20% off.

0 of 16 copy ads carry a proof number, so buyers only hear claims like lowest prices and quick shipping. Claims alone make a big sofa purchase feel risky. Lead the next three ads with your 4.5 rating on the creative.

3 Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, not the piece the ad shows. A buyer who clicked one sofa must search again, which costs a sale. Point each to the product page of the piece in its creative.

Your 16 copy ads open 9 different ways, and the biggest two each lead 3 ads. Spread this thin, no promise gets seen enough to stick. Keep the handpicked line and the dream line and build the next batch on both.
